title: Jason's logbook
summary: Jason's logbook was a large book used by Jason which mapped and detailed the adventures of the Argonauts on their quest to find the Golden Fleece.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
In ancient times, [[Jason]] and his [[Argonauts]] had their adventures recorded in a logbook. It became sunk with the [[Argo]] and the various treasures of the Argonauts, including the [[Hoplite]] [[Titans]], just off the coast of [[Sutos Island]].  {{source|The Treasures of the Argonauts}} The wreckage eventually was uncovered by [[Dante Vale]]'s [[Huntik Foundation]] team, and the logbook recovered by [[Zhalia Moon]]. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}
